FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 12, 2010, AT 8:30 A.M. EST

ADVANCE MONTHLY SALES FOR RETAIL AND FOOD SERVICES
January 2010

The U.S. Census Bureau announced today that advance estimates of U.S. retail
and food services sales for January, adjusted for seasonal variation and
holiday and trading-day differences, but not for price changes, were $355.8
billion, an increase of 0.5 percent from the previous month.

The November to December 2009 percent change was revised from -0.3 percent to
-0.1 percent.
